📈 盤前心理學｜帳上一檔股票小賺，另一檔還套著。今天只能賣一檔，你的手會先伸向哪一檔？

有篇研究用台灣的真實交易紀錄看了這件事。研究者分析台灣證交所截至1999年的五年間「全部」交易：超過十億筆、近四百萬名投資人，而且知道每筆是誰下的。

研究發現，整體來看，投資人持股賺錢時賣出的機率，大約是賠錢時的兩倍。這種「賣賺錢的比賣賠錢的快」的傾向，學界稱為「處分效應」。在當時，84%的台灣投資人都呈現這個模式。

分群來看更有意思：個人、公司法人、自營商都不太願意實現虧損。投信和外資則沒有這種傾向，不過兩者加起來只佔不到5%的交易金額。

要提醒的是，這是二十多年前的資料，描述的是當時的行為模式。它沒有說哪種做法比較好，也不能直接套用到今天的市場。但下次想賣股票時，或許可以留意一下，自己是不是也有這個傾向 🤔

（研究分享，不是投資建議）
why: 系列第一篇，用台灣自己的完整交易紀錄和兩個好記的數字（兩倍、84%）開場最貼近讀者，而且是真實行為資料，不是預測模型；要註明這是1990年代後期的資料。

paper.title: Is the Aggregate Investor Reluctant to Realise Losses? Evidence from Taiwan
paper.abstract: We ask whether the typical investor and the aggregate investor exhibit a bias known as the disposition effect, the tendency to sell investments that are held for a profit at a faster rate than investments held for a loss. We analyse all trading activity on the Taiwan Stock Exchange (TSE) for the five years ending in 1999. Using a dataset that contains all trades (over one billion) and the identity of every trader (nearly four million), we find that in aggregate, investors in Taiwan are about twice as likely to sell a stock if they are holding that stock for a gain rather than a loss. Eighty-four percent of all Taiwanese investors sell winners at a faster rate than losers. Individuals, corporations, and dealers are reluctant to realise losses, while mutual funds and foreigners, who together account for less than 5% of all trades (by value), are not.

🏭 產業前沿｜一次「讀入資料」要花多少電？

量子演算法常假設，把傳統資料讀進量子電腦幾乎免費。這篇論文改把它當成硬體耗能來算：以超導量子處理器上、12個位址量子位元的一次QRAM查詢為例，查詢保真度約0.969，動態能耗約3.51×10⁻⁴焦耳，平均動態功率約4.38瓦。

研究也發現，同樣的保真度目標下，操作點與冷凍機各級的衰減分配，可能讓平均功率差到兩倍以上。

要注意：這是模型計算，不是實測，而且假設相當樂觀（相干時間約1秒，約高出現有紀錄三個數量級；冷卻效率取理論上限；靜態功率設為零）。

論文做到的是把能耗納入評估；如果成真，可能讓低溫設備與量子硬體的設計多一個能耗與冷卻的視角。離實際產品還很遠。

（研究分享，不是投資建議）
why: 今天午間需要一篇前沿技術論文，這篇尚未用過，且能清楚分開「論文做到的」與「可能的產業影響」，也避免與昨天的台股交易行為文章重複。

paper.title: The energetic cost of loading classical data in quantum computers
paper.abstract: Quantum algorithms for machine learning, chemistry, and cryptanalysis often assume coherent access to classical data at negligible physical cost. We instead treat data loading as a hardware process and quantify the dynamic energetic cost of a quantum random access memory (QRAM) query on a superconducting processor. Using the metric-noise-resource framework, we relate query fidelity and power to gate duration, relative two-qubit drive strength, and the distribution of attenuation across a multi-stage refrigerator, while accounting for thermal photons and gate errors. We analyze the linear-depth multiplexer and the noise-resilient bucket-brigade architectures, adapting the latter to a native superconducting gate set and refining its fidelity analysis using the fully decomposed gate schedule. For a representative bucket-brigade QRAM query with a $12$-qubit address register we obtain a query fidelity of $0.969$. The query consumes $3.51\times10^{-4}\,\mathrm{J}$ of dynamic energy, corresponding to an average dynamic power of $4.38\,\mathrm{W}$ and a peak of $64.4\,\mathrm{W}$. Our optimization shows that, at fixed target fidelity, the operating point and attenuation profile can change the average power by a factor of two or more.

text:
🌙 盤後研究室｜如果手上有一個股市每一筆交易、每一張委託單的完整紀錄，會看到什麼？

研究者取得台灣證交所 1995 至 1999 年所有投資人的交易資料。當時個人投資者約占九成成交金額。

研究估計，個人投資者的整體投資組合，每年報酬被拉低約 3.8 個百分點（含交易虧損、手續費、交易稅與擇時損失）。另一個算法是，五年的總損失約 9,350 億新台幣，相當於當時 GDP 的 2.2%。研究發現，幾乎所有交易虧損都可追溯到「積極委託」，也就是用較搶的價格求快速成交。法人扣除手續費與稅後，每年多約 1.5 個百分點。

這是 1990 年代末台灣的歷史資料，描述的是整體平均，不是每一個人，也不是現在該怎麼做的建議。

（研究分享，不是投資建議）
why: Taiwan's market-wide data is a strong fit for local readers and adds a fresh study and angle after yesterday's disposition-effect post, avoiding a repeat of the same paper and steering clear of today's stock-specific headlines.

paper.title: Just How Much Do Individual Investors Lose by Trading?
paper.abstract: Individual investor trading results in systematic and economically large losses. Using a complete trading history of all investors in Taiwan, we document that the aggregate portfolio of individuals suffers an annual performance penalty of 3.8 percentage points. Individual investor losses are equivalent to 2.2% of Taiwan's gross domestic product or 2.8% of the total personal income. Virtually all individual trading losses can be traced to their aggressive orders. In contrast, institutions enjoy an annual performance boost of 1.5 percentage points, and both the aggressive and passive trades of institutions are profitable.

text:
📈 盤前心理學｜打開看盤軟體，上千檔股票，你會從哪一檔開始看？

Barber 與 Odean 在 2008 年發表的研究，檢驗並證實一個假說：個人投資者整體而言是「吸引注意的股票」的淨買方，例如上新聞的股票、成交量異常放大的股票，以及單日報酬極端的股票。

他們的解釋是搜尋問題：要買，得在成千上萬檔股票裡找；要賣，個人投資者通常只賣手上已有的股票，不用大海撈針。所以他們推測，許多人只會考慮買先吸引到自己注意的股票：注意力先決定選項範圍，偏好才在範圍內做選擇。

這是在描述注意力如何影響選擇，不是在說這類股票該買或不該買。

（研究分享，不是投資建議）
why: 這幾天連續用台灣交易資料的處分效果與損失研究，今天換成美股資料的注意力偏誤，是全新的研究與角度，也避開近期重複。

paper.title: All That Glitters: The Effect of Attention and News on the Buying Behavior of Individual and Institutional Investors
paper.abstract: We test and confirm the hypothesis that individual investors are net buyers of attention-grabbing stocks, e.g., stocks in the news, stocks experiencing high abnormal trading volume, and stocks with extreme one-day returns. Attention-driven buying results from the difficulty that investors have searching the thousands of stocks they can potentially buy. Individual investors do not face the same search problem when selling because they tend to sell only stocks they already own. We hypothesize that many investors consider purchasing only stocks that have first caught their attention. Thus, preferences determine choices after attention has determined the choice set.

text:
🏭 產業前沿｜輸入有一半是零，算得反而更慢？

這篇 FPGA 論文的作者就遇到：跳過零值後，他們原本的引擎在 50% 稀疏度時，整張影像比密集輸入慢了 2.7 倍。問題不在乘法，而在累加：部分和零散抵達，得一再讀出、改寫。

論文做到的是把累加改成「每個結果只寫一次」，並分到不會互相衝突的記憶體分塊。RTL 模擬中，稀疏度約 70% 以內，速度貼近前端上限（差距 0.5% 內）；50–80% 稀疏度下，比一種散射式累加設計快 1.10–1.26 倍。代價是記憶體用量比早期版本多（BRAM 81 對 69）。

如果成真，可能影響的是邊緣 AI 推論晶片在「用記憶體換速度」上的取捨。但這只是 LeNet-5 小網路、固定 3×3 資料流的設計成果，其中 conv2 層端到端只有密集版的 0.87 倍速，離商用還有距離。

（研究分享，不是投資建議）
why: 昨天的量子QRAM已用過硬體題，今天換成AI推論硬體的不同層面，且不重複用同一篇；其他候選多為純模型評測，缺少可對應產業的內容。

paper.title: SkipLane: Write-Once, Conflict-Free Accumulation for Zero-Skipping CNN Engines on FPGAs
paper.abstract: Skipping zero activations saves multiplications in CNN accelerators, but it complicates accumulation: the products in a compressed input window belong to different output columns and must be merged. In our earlier engine, this merging was done by read-modify-write (RMW) of a row buffer, which made sparse inputs slower than dense ones even at 87% sparsity. Existing designs either merge kernel rows through RMW or reduce bank conflicts with extra hardware, without eliminating them. SkipLane makes the entire accumulation path write-once. Each kernel row is processed in its own lane, which holds partial sums in three registers and retires up to three finished columns per cycle into memory banks that cannot conflict. Lanes and input channels are summed only at readout, so no partial sum is ever read back. Multipliers left idle by zero weights compute a second filter in the same pass. In RTL simulation, the engine stays within 0.5% of its frontend bound up to 70% sparsity and is 1.10-1.26$\times$ faster than an SCNN-style scatter accumulator with 18 banks and ideal RMW at 50-80% sparsity. Six engines meet 140 MHz on a PYNQ-Z2 using 21.1k LUTs and run LeNet-5 bit-exact on the board. For conv1, the engine needs 1.94$\times$ fewer cycles than a dense engine (1.26$\times$ faster end to end); for conv2, whose rows are only 13 pixels wide, it reaches 0.87$\times$ the dense speed.

text:
🌙 盤後研究室｜今年當沖賺最多的人，明年還會是贏家嗎？

研究者分析台灣 1992 至 2006 年的當沖交易者：先依某一年（y 年）的報酬排名，再追蹤他們在隔年（y+1 年）的表現。結果 y 年排名最前面的 500 名，隔年平均每天費前報酬 61.3 bps，扣費後 37.9 bps；y 年排名墊底的人，隔年費前 -11.5 bps，扣費後 -28.9 bps。

更關鍵的是，研究發現只有不到 1% 的當沖交易者，能可預測且穩定地賺到扣費後的正異常報酬。

這代表：在這份資料中，交易者之間的表現差異確實存在，但能持續做到的人極少。這不代表任何人該怎麼操作，也不能直接推論到其他時期或市場。🙂

（研究分享，不是投資建議）
why: 這是還沒用過的台灣真實交易資料研究，與近三天的處分效果、虧損、注意力偏誤都不同角度；同時避開今天以單一公司和執行長新聞為主的頭條，不硬掛新聞。

paper.title: The cross-section of speculator skill: Evidence from day trading
paper.abstract: We document economically large cross-sectional differences in the before- and after-fee returns earned by speculative traders by analyzing day traders in Taiwan from 1992 to 2006. We sort day traders based on their returns in year y and analyze their performance in year y+1; the 500 top-ranked day traders go on to earn daily before-fee (after-fee) returns of 61.3 (37.9) bps per day; bottom-ranked day traders go on to earn daily before-fee (after-fee) returns of -11.5 (-28.9) bps per day. Less than 1% of the day trader population is able to predictably and reliably earn positive abnormal returns net of fees.

📈 盤前心理學｜如果券商 App 當機，哪些股票的交易會少得最多？

一項美國研究用某手機券商的資料發現：高關注度的股票，交易減少得特別多。研究者認為，這款 App 的用戶比其他散戶更常「因為被注意到而交易」。

原因可能不只一個。一部分與用戶多為較沒經驗的投資人一致，但研究也指出，App 本身的獨特功能同樣有部分影響。

摘要還提到，這群用戶集中買進的股票，後續 20 天的平均異常報酬為 -4.7%。

這不代表用手機下單的人都如此，研究比較的是這款 App 用戶與其他散戶。

（研究分享，不是投資建議）
why: 目前股市系列都用台灣證交所 1990 年代資料，這篇是較新的美股券商資料，也避免連續重複同一篇研究，並延伸 11-12 的注意力主題但切入點是 App 設計。

paper.title: Attention-Induced Trading and Returns: Evidence from Robinhood Users
paper.abstract: We study the influence of financial innovation by fintech brokerages on individual investors' trading and stock prices. Using data from Robinhood, we find that Robinhood investors engage in more attention-induced trading than other retail investors. For example, Robinhood outages disproportionately reduce trading in high-attention stocks. While this evidence is consistent with Robinhood attracting relatively inexperienced investors, we show that it is also driven in part by the app's unique features. Consistent with models of attention-induced trading, intense buying by Robinhood users forecasts negative returns. Average 20-day abnormal returns are -4.7% for the top stocks purchased each day.

text:
🏭 產業前沿｜8萬顆AI加速器，每一顆都在自己的高頻寬記憶體（HBM）裡存一份一模一樣的模型權重，有必要嗎？

瑞典烏普薩拉大學團隊提議：權重是唯讀的，改由一台伺服器透過光纖持續廣播，加速器直接接收，不先存進本地記憶體。

論文做到的是建模評估：在8萬顆加速器的規模下，估計可省下約4.00–8.44 PB的HBM（39–82%）。在選定的權重切分方式下，解碼吞吐量為HBM基準系統的0.96–1.57倍，每個token的能耗低10–42%。但若把整個模型串流給每顆加速器，吞吐量只剩基準的0.25–0.47倍。

如果成真，可能改變AI伺服器對HBM的需求結構。不過這是架構分析與模型估算，不是做出來的系統，論文也把部分硬體成本留給未來研究。

（研究分享，不是投資建議）
why: 今天要選一篇還沒用過的前沿技術論文，記憶體與 AI 伺服器是關注股市的人常聽到的供應鏈環節，跟前兩天的量子與 FPGA 題材不同，也不涉及任何公司。

paper.title: Broadcast, Don't Replicate: Eliminating Weight HBM in Datacenter LLM Serving
paper.abstract: Large language model (LLM) inference at datacenter scale is fundamentally bottlenecked by memory capacity and bandwidth limits. Because model weights are read-only and identical across instances, conventional architectures that replicate these parameters across the local DRAM of tens of thousands of accelerators incur massive capital expenditures, significant static power dissipation, and redundant memory-fetch energy. A recent proposal to use optical fiber loops as delay-line memory alleviates these issues, but its recirculating loop must hold the whole model: loop length grows with model size, slack is fixed when the ring is built, and the layouts that serve modern Mixture of Experts (MoE) models efficiently do not fit in it. We propose Optical Broadcast Memory (OBM), an open-ended hierarchical Tap-and-Amplify fiber architecture that generalizes and replaces the optical ring paradigm. A centralized memory server continuously broadcasts weights to distributed inference nodes that passively tap the data stream using receive-only co-packaged optics, delivering parameters directly to compute units without intermediate buffering. To overcome the limitations of continuous weight streaming, we use dynamically-sized slack to accommodate large and variable context lengths. We show how removing the restrictions of the optical ring allows OBM to efficiently serve MoE models. Evaluated at a datacenter scale of 80,000 accelerators, OBM eliminates petabytes of HBM while being competitive or better in throughput and energy per token than an HBM-based system.

🌙 盤後研究室｜晚上想問一個小問題：你上次點開某檔股票的頁面，是因為原本就在研究它，還是因為它剛好一直出現在眼前？

早上提過的券商 App 當機研究，用的是一款金融科技券商 App 的資料。研究發現，這款 App 的投資人比其他散戶有更多「受注意力驅動」的交易。當機時，高關注股票的交易減少得比較多。作者指出，這與平台吸引較缺乏經驗的投資人一致，但部分也和 App 的獨特功能有關。

摘要還提到，該平台用戶大量買進的股票，後續報酬為負：每天被買最多的那些股票，20 日平均異常報酬為 -4.7%。

這只是針對單一平台的研究，不代表任何人該怎麼操作。它更像一面鏡子：下單前，先問自己是被吸引，還是早有功課。

（研究分享，不是投資建議）
why: 今天早上用了這篇研究的當機發現，晚上用同一篇換成自我檢視角度，且避開今天以單一公司為主的新聞頭條；同時避免連續重複前幾天已用過的台灣交易資料研究。

📈 盤前心理學｜散戶虧錢，是因為選錯股票嗎？

有篇研究取得1995至1999年台灣證交所全市場的逐筆交易與委託資料。研究發現，個人投資者的損失幾乎都來自「積極下單」，也就是為了快點成交，買價掛得高、賣價掛得低。被動掛單短期反而有獲利，拉長時間則是小幅虧損。

（研究分享，不是投資建議）
why: 這篇11-11晚間用過整體虧損的發現，今天改從「虧損來自哪裡」這個新角度切入，不重複同一個數字開場，也避開昨天的注意力主題與連續使用同一篇的問題。

🏭 產業前沿｜AI資料中心選電源，關鍵可能不是電價，而是「多久才有電」。

這篇美國研究用模型比較四種供電方式：交流或直流耦合的太陽能+儲能、離網天然氣、併聯電網。把等電期間閒置晶片的運算價值（以每GPU小時2.4美元估算）算進去後，直流耦合太陽能+儲能在約85%的美國地點成本最低；若天然氣縮短到3年，降到約55%。直流平均也比交流省約18%。

論文做到的是這個成本比較；如果成真，可能讓儲能電池與電力轉換設備更受重視。作者提到，直流的節能幅度與一個示範設施的觀察相符，但100 MW以上的整合系統仍需實證，部分直流設備的供應鏈也尚未成熟。

（研究分享，不是投資建議）
why: 近日產業前沿多為晶片與量子題材，這篇講電力與資料中心基礎設施，角度不同，且與市場關注的AI投資主題相關，又不涉及個股。

paper.title: Speed-to-Power Dominates Energy Costs for AI Data Centers: Technoeconomic Analysis of Powering AI in the Continental United States
paper.abstract: The rapid growth of artificial intelligence is driving demand for new data centers at large scale and on short deployment timelines. To power them, firms connect to the commercial grid or contract generation directly, but interconnection and gas-turbine delays now incentivize on-site generation. We compare grid-connected and off-grid data center energy infrastructure (AC- and DC-coupled solar-plus-storage, islanded natural gas, and grid interconnection) across the continental U.S. Using an open-source technoeconomic framework built on empirically calibrated AI training loads, climate-driven cooling, stage-by-stage power conversion, and physics-based battery degradation, we model designs providing equivalent energy services. Our central contribution is a speed-adjusted cost of energy that values the compute unlocked by faster construction, making options with different deployment timelines directly comparable on one physically consistent basis. We find DC coupling reduces lifetime energy costs by 18% ($0.09/ kWh) on average versus AC counterparts by eliminating inverters and improving efficiency. Though rarely cheapest on unadjusted energy cost, DC-coupled microgrids' faster deployment makes them the lowest-cost modeled option in 85% of U.S. locations once foregone compute is valued, or 55% under accelerated natural gas timelines. For AI infrastructure, deployment speed rather than unit energy cost determines the economically preferred path to power.

text:
🌙 盤後研究室｜如果把三萬五千多戶家庭的股票帳戶攤開來看，會發現什麼？

Barber 與 Odean 分析一家大型折扣券商 1991 年 2 月到 1997 年 1 月、逾 3.5 萬戶家庭的帳戶資料。研究發現，男性的交易量比女性多 45%。交易也讓男性的淨報酬每年少掉 2.65 個百分點，女性則是 1.72 個百分點。

研究者的解釋是：理論預測過度自信的投資人會交易過度，而心理學研究顯示，在金融這類領域男性比女性更過度自信。所以他們用性別來檢驗這個預測。

但要留意，這是對群體平均的描述，不代表每個人。資料也只來自 1990 年代的單一券商，不能直接套用到現在的台股或美股。摘要沒有直接測量每個人的自信程度。

（研究分享，不是投資建議）
why: 近期貼文已多次談台灣交易資料與注意力偏誤，這篇是用美國帳戶資料談過度自信與交易量的新角度，也和週日晚上檢視自己交易習慣的氛圍相符，並避開今天高度集中在單一公司人物的新聞。

paper.title: Boys will be Boys: Gender, Overconfidence, and Common Stock Investment
paper.abstract: Theoretical models predict that overconfident investors trade excessively. We test this prediction by partitioning investors on gender. Psychological research demonstrates that, in areas such as finance, men are more overconfident than women. Thus, theory predicts that men will trade more excessively than women. Using account data for over 35,000 households from a large discount brokerage, we analyze the common stock investments of men and women from February 1991 through January 1997. We document that men trade 45 percent more than women. Trading reduces men's net returns by 2.65 percentage points a year as opposed to 1.72 percentage points for women.

text:
📈 盤前心理學｜11.4% 對 17.9%。

這是一項研究裡，交易最頻繁的家庭，和同期整體市場的年報酬差距。

研究者追蹤美國一家大型折扣券商 1991 至 1996 年間 66,465 戶家庭的帳戶。結果發現，交易最勤的那群家庭年報酬 11.4%，市場是 17.9%。平均家庭是 16.4%，投資組合每年約換手 75%。

作者認為，過度自信可以解釋為什麼交易這麼頻繁，績效又偏弱。

這代表什麼、不代表什麼：這是 1991 至 1996 年美國單一券商的資料，摘要說的是這段期間的結果，並不能直接推論到今天的台股或每個人。

（研究分享，不是投資建議）
why: 這是還沒用過的經典散戶交易研究，有具體數字，並與近期台灣交易資料的貼文形成互補，不重複已講過的處分效果、注意力與當沖題材。

paper.title: Trading Is Hazardous to Your Wealth: The Common Stock Investment Performance of Individual Investors
paper.abstract: Individual investors who hold common stocks directly pay a tremendous performance penalty for active trading. Of 66,465 households with accounts at a large discount broker during 1991 to 1996, those that trade most earn an annual return of 11.4 percent, while the market returns 17.9 percent. The average household earns an annual return of 16.4 percent, tilts its common stock investment toward high-beta, small, value stocks, and turns over 75 percent of its portfolio annually. Overconfidence can explain high trading levels and the resulting poor performance of individual investors. Our central message is that trading is hazardous to your wealth.

text:
🏭 產業前沿｜一個 70 億參數的模型，用 16 位元存要約 14 GB，比多數邊緣模組的記憶體還大。

論文指出，現行量化格式對每個編碼都花一樣多位元，但實際數值分布很不均勻。研究團隊把編碼調得更好壓縮，再做無損壓縮，用到時才由小型解碼單元還原。在相同困惑度預算下，模型比最佳的固定位寬格式小 5.7–31.4%。

論文做到的是減少記憶體搬運量；如果成真，可能影響的是端側 AI 裝置在記憶體容量與頻寬之間的取捨。

但離產品還遠：解碼單元只做到合成與 FPGA 驗證，不是實際晶片，延遲最多降 36%、能耗最多降 38% 是推算值，也只測了三個模型。

（研究分享，不是投資建議）
why: 本週noon已連續談量子、FPGA稀疏、HBM廣播與資料中心供電，今天換成邊緣裝置的記憶體瓶頸，是新角度；也避開純模型基準或無關行為的論文。

paper.title: LazyWeights: Decode-on-Demand Edge LLMs
paper.abstract: Memory decides which LLMs an edge device runs, and how fast: capacity on a $4$ GB Jetson Nano, bandwidth on an $8$ GB Jetson Orin Nano Super. Deployed formats (GPTQ, AWQ, $\texttt{llama.cpp}$'s K- and I-quants) spend equal bits on every integer code of a matrix, although the codes are far from uniform. $\texttt{LazyWeights}$ keeps these formats but tunes GPTQ so the codes compress, Huffman-codes them losslessly in interleaved lanes, and decodes them on demand in a small unit between DRAM and L2, so GPU kernels run unchanged and DRAM moves only coded bytes. At $1\%$ and $3.5\%$ perplexity budgets, coded Phi-3-mini, Mistral-7B and SmolLM-1.7B are $5.7-31.4\%$ smaller than the best $\texttt{llama.cpp}$ format. A bit-exact $0.21$ mm$^2$ ASIC decoder unit ($1$ GHz, $7$ nm) cuts Orin latency and energy per token by up to $36\%$ and $38\%$ ($54\%$ and $44\%$ with prompt-lookup speculation). On the Nano, $\texttt{LazyWeights}$ needs $58-64\%$ less time and $53-57\%$ less energy per token than CPU $\texttt{llama.cpp}$, and runs a streamed Mistral-7B 6.6$\times$ faster at $3.89$ bits per weight. A Huffman decoder beats an rANS decoder in rate and area at equal throughput; the ASIC decoder unit runs bit-exact on a Zynq UltraScale+ FPGA (AMD ZCU102).

text:
🌙 盤後研究室｜經濟不景氣時，樂透的需求會上升；股票市場裡，有沒有類似的模式？

Alok Kumar 發表於《Journal of Finance》（2009）的研究發現，個人投資者整體偏愛帶有樂透特徵的股票，而且和樂透需求一樣，這類股票的需求在不景氣時更高。

研究也發現，會讓人花更多錢買樂透的社經因素，與更多投資樂透型股票相關。摘要指出這類股票表現不佳，而過度重押它們的低收入投資者，與賭博相關的落後幅度更大。

這說的是群體層面的相關模式，不代表每位投資人的動機，也不是在評斷誰。以上僅依據論文摘要。

回頭想想：自己選股時，最先看的是什麼？

（研究分享，不是投資建議）
why: 目前系列已談過處分效果、注意力、過度交易與性別，還沒碰「賭博傾向」這個角度；選它能增加變化，且今天的頭條都圍繞單一人物與公司，不適合硬扯成市場連結，所以用提問收尾。

paper.title: Who Gambles in the Stock Market?
paper.abstract: This study shows that the propensity to gamble and investment decisions are correlated. At the aggregate level, individual investors prefer stocks with lottery features, and like lottery demand, the demand for lottery-type stocks increases during economic downturns. In the cross-section, socioeconomic factors that induce greater expenditure in lotteries are associated with greater investment in lottery-type stocks. Further, lottery investment levels are higher in regions with favorable lottery environments. Because lottery-type stocks underperform, gambling-related underperformance is greater among low-income investors who excessively overweight lottery-type stocks. These results indicate that state lotteries and lottery-type stocks attract very similar socioeconomic clienteles.

text:
📈 盤前心理學｜如果你想知道大家最近在關注哪支股票，最直接的辦法可能是看他們在 Google 搜尋什麼。

Da、Engelberg 與 Gao 就這樣做了。他們用 Google 搜尋量指數（SVI）當作投資人注意力的直接指標，分析 2004 至 2008 年美國羅素 3000 成分股。

研究發現，SVI 和既有的注意力指標相關但不相同，反應也更即時，而且可能反映的是散戶的注意力。搜尋量上升後，股價在接下來兩週傾向偏高，一年內則出現反轉。SVI 也和 IPO 股票首日的大幅報酬、長期表現落後有關。

這是特定年份、特定市場的研究結果，描述的是注意力與價格的關係，不是進出場的依據。

（研究分享，不是投資建議）
why: 近日已連發多篇台灣交易資料與券商App注意力研究，這篇換成搜尋行為的新資料來源，延續注意力主題但角度不同，且尚未用過。

paper.title: In Search of Attention
paper.abstract: We propose a new and direct measure of investor attention using search frequency in Google (Search Volume Index (SVI)). In a sample of Russell 3000 stocks from 2004 to 2008, we find that SVI (1) is correlated with but different from existing proxies of investor attention; (2) captures investor attention in a more timely fashion and (3) likely measures the attention of retail investors. An increase in SVI predicts higher stock prices in the next 2 weeks and an eventual price reversal within the year. It also contributes to the large first-day return and long-run underperformance of IPO stocks.

text:
🏭 產業前沿｜一個通用的 AI 原子模型，在鈉離子電池的硬碳上，連「兩個鈉原子會不會靠在一起」都算錯，你會怎麼辦？

這篇論文測了多個預訓練模型，發現它們在鈉簇聚在石墨烯上的情況表現不佳：第一原理計算(DFT)顯示兩個鈉有穩定距離，預訓練模型卻預測互相排斥。作者用針對性資料微調後，誤差從 32.43 降到 1.65 meV/原子。更廣的資料集微調後，測試集誤差約 10.70 meV/原子。

論文做到的是模擬層面的準確度，也看到小孔洞的電壓較高、大孔洞較低。如果成真，可能讓材料篩選的計算更快；但這是理想化的圓柱孔模型，離實際電池產品還有一段距離，作者也坦承部分結構的預測仍和 DFT 有差。

（研究分享，不是投資建議）
why: 近日產業前沿多談AI硬體、記憶體與資料中心電力，這篇換成電池材料，補上較少出現的材料領域，也避開已用過的主題。

paper.title: Fine-tuned atomistic foundation model for accurate sodium-carbon chemistry in Na-ion batteries
paper.abstract: Atomistic foundation models have emerged as a promising route to DFT-level accuracy for materials simulation with complex chemical environments. However, their reliability across competing bonding regimes and, more importantly, how complex bonding affects predictions of material properties remain unclear. Among materials with competing bonding regimes, sodium storage in hard carbon poses a substantial challenge. Hard carbon features diverse local structural motifs, including defective and curved graphitic regions, amorphous regions, and closed/open pores. Motivated by its importance for Na-ion batteries, we systematically evaluate existing pretrained foundation models based on the MACE architecture across different local Na/C motifs. We find that the pretrained models fail to accurately capture Na-Na and Na-C interactions for metallic Na clusters on graphene. To recover a DFT-level energetic description, we employ targeted fine-tuning, showing that it can describe the energetic stability of local motifs and achieve sufficient transferability to unseen Na/C environments. With the developed fine-tuned model, we establish a correlation between closed-pore radius in hard carbon and plateau voltage, showing that the small pores contribute at larger voltages than large ones, suggesting thus how the developed fine-tuned foundation model can link atomistic information with materials design for complex bonding environments.

text:
🌙 盤後研究室｜為什麼有些人明明可以投資股市，卻一直沒進場？理論上，資訊成本與交易成本這類「摩擦」，可能是原因之一。

Bogan（2008）用家戶的追蹤資料，看股市參與率的變化。摘要只寫「過去十年」，沒有列出確切年份，也沒有說是哪個地區的家戶。研究發現，使用電腦與網路的家庭，參與率提高的幅度，大於沒有使用的家庭。作者把這個變化連結到網路降低了這些摩擦。

摘要還有一個換算：參與機率的增幅，相當於多了超過 27,000 美元的家戶收入，或多了超過兩年的平均教育年數。

這不代表上網就會讓人投資，也不是在談今天的行情。摘要呈現的是「門檻變低」與「參與提高」連在一起，我們能讀到的就是這一層。

（研究分享，不是投資建議）
why: 近期貼文都在談交易偏誤與注意力,這篇換成「誰會進入股市」的參與題材,而且今天的標題多為恐慌式個股新聞,不適合硬掛,用研究本身帶出新角度。

paper.title: Stock Market Participation and the Internet
paper.abstract: Theory indicates that frictions (e. g., information and transaction costs) could account for the lower than expected stock market participation rates. This paper examines the hypothesis that there has been a fundamental change in participation and links this change to the reduction of these frictions by the advent of the Internet. Using panel data on household participation rates over the past decade, the results show computer/Internet using households raised participation substantially more than non-computer using households. The increased probability of participation was equivalent to having over $27,000 in additional household income or over two more mean years of education.
paper.venue: Journal of Financial and Quantitative Analysis

text:
📈 盤前心理學｜愛社交的人，比較會買股票嗎？

《Review of Finance》上的一篇研究（Balloch 等人），探討家庭為什麼參與股市。研究發現，「對股市的理解程度」和「對股市的信任」是兩條各自獨立的管道，同時解釋了家庭有沒有持股，以及有持股的家庭把多少比例放在股票上。

有趣的是，一旦把股市理解程度考慮進去，社交性對是否參與就不再顯著。研究的結論是：重要的是理解，而不是社交。

另外，經濟衝擊與對未來的預期，也是解釋是否參與的關鍵行為特徵。至於投多少，則需要更多的行為特徵來解釋。

這是在看研究如何解釋「參與股市」，不是建議誰該不該進場。

（研究分享，不是投資建議）
why: 近期貼文已連續談過台灣交易資料、注意力與參與摩擦，這篇切入「金融知識與信任」是新角度，且屬於真實家戶資料的行為研究，能讓本週題材更多元。

paper.title: Stock Market Literacy, Trust, and Participation
paper.abstract: This article studies the importance of stock market literacy and trust for stock ownership decisions. We find that these two distinct channels simultaneously explain not only the probability of participation, but, conditional on participation, also explain the share of investment in stocks. Once we account for stock market literacy, sociability is no longer significant for participation; what matters is literacy rather than sociability. Further, we observe that economic shocks and future expectations are key behavioral characteristics that explain a household’s decision to invest in stocks. However, upon participation, a larger set of behavioral characteristics explains the level of stock investment.

text:
🏭 產業前沿｜把一個記憶體單元的面積縮小約625倍，代價是什麼？

這篇論文把鋁鈧氮（AlScN）鐵電層薄到10奈米，在2KB（128×128）的無選擇器交叉陣列中做出200奈米單元。和先前同容量、5微米單元的陣列相比，面積縮小約625倍；單顆接面最小做到100奈米。

代價在數據裡：283顆隨機抽測單元，ON/OFF比平均約43、整流比平均約61。以10%讀取餘裕估算，免選擇器只能讀約26×26的子陣列。實際寫入速率約10–50 kHz，遠慢於電容測得的50奈秒，寫入耐久度也還沒確立。

論文做到的是元件展示；如果成真，可能影響的是高密度非揮發記憶體與記憶體內運算這類供應鏈環節，但上述限制，論文都列為待解決的問題。

（研究分享，不是投資建議）
why: 近日產業前沿多談AI加速器、FPGA、電源與量化壓縮，這篇換成記憶體材料與元件層級的題目，有具體數字，也和關注記憶體產業的台股讀者相關。

paper.title: Multilevel AlScN Ferroelectric Diode Crossbar Arrays with Sub-200 nm Cells for Selector-Free Nonvolatile Memory
paper.abstract: Passive crossbar arrays are a leading route to high-density nonvolatile memory and in-memory computing, but without a selector the memory element itself must supply the nonlinearity that suppresses sneak-path currents. Here we scale aluminum scandium nitride (AlScN) ferroelectric diodes (FeDs) in both dimensions that matter - the ferroelectric is thinned to 10 nm and the junction diameter is reduced to 100 nm. We further integrate 200 nm cells into a 2-kilobyte (128 * 128) passive crossbar. At a junction area of 0.0314 um2 this is a ~625 reduction in cell area, at equal array capacity, relative to kilobyte-scale AlScN FeD crossbars built on 5 μm cells. The 10 nm Al0.64Sc0.36N layer reverses its polarization under pulses of 50 ns full width at half maximum at a pulse-energy density of ~16 pJ μm-2, corresponding to ~0.5 pJ per 200 nm cell. Pulsed programming at 17.5 V and 1 kHz yields an ON/OFF ratio of 4.2 * 103 in a 200 nm cell, while DC characterization of 283 randomly addressed cells of the 2-kB array gives ON/OFF and rectification ratios at 5 V of 43 33 and 61 74, from which we derive the sub-array size that selector-free reading currently supports. Eight conductance levels (three bits) written into a 200 nm array cell remain resolvable for 103 s, and the two extreme states are stable beyond 5 * 104 s. Mapping the measured, nonuniformly spaced levels onto a ResNet-20 network recovers 91.7 +- 0.1 % CIFAR-10 accuracy after quantization-aware training, against a 92.2 +- 0.1 % full-precision baseline. AlScN FeDs thus combine nanosecond switching, three-bit storage and sub-0.05 μm2 cells in a BEOL-compatible, selector-free crossbar.

text:
🌙 盤後研究室｜單一股票的槓桿型 ETF，都選在什麼樣的股票上推出？

研究看的是美股 2023 年 2 月以後推出的這類產品（單一股票槓桿 ETF 最早 2022 年才出現）。推出前，標的股票的波動度中位數約在前 1,000 大股票的第 94 百分位，過去六個月報酬約第 92 百分位。也就是波動大、又剛漲過一輪。研究者認為，這可能是在迎合散戶對樂透式報酬的偏好。

但波動大也會墊高成本。在研究的假設下，標的每日波動 5% 時，2 倍產品要標的全年漲近 100%，才追平直接持有。

對照之下，廣泛指數型槓桿 ETF 在 2006 年至 2025 年 9 月的樣本中，為投資人帶來逾 1,000 億美元獲利，比同樣資金投入標的資產多逾 400 億美元。不過這段期間股市報酬偏強。

這不是買賣建議，只說明：同樣是槓桿，標的不同，結果差很多。

（研究分享，不是投資建議）
why: 這是未用過的新論文，主題是散戶偏好與產品設計，和近期的注意力、交易頻率題材不同，今天沒有大盤新聞，所以用 finding 當盤後研究室。

paper.title: The Costs and Benefits of Leveraged ETFs
paper.abstract: We study the costs and benefits of leveraged ETFs (LETFs), focusing on five determinants of performance: volatility drag, fees, financing costs, product launches, and market timing. Long broad-equity-index LETFs generated more than 100 billion US dollars in investor gains, including over 40 billion US dollars relative to counterfactual investments in the underlying assets, due to modest structural headwinds and rising markets. Single-stock LETFs, however, are launched on stocks near the top of the volatility and past-return distributions. This caters to retail demand for lottery-like payoffs, but it also creates larger volatility drag, higher financing costs, and greater exposure to losses from poor market timing.

text:
📈 盤前心理學｜同一個股票話題，在三個社群平台上，「大家」的看法會一樣嗎？

Cookson 等人比較了 Twitter、StockTwits 與 Seeking Alpha。研究發現，即使控制公司公告與新聞，各平台的「關注度」（討論熱度）仍高度相關；但「情緒」（偏樂觀或悲觀）卻不一致，各平台共通的情緒成分，解釋力只比各平台自己的獨特情緒多一點點。

作者利用市場事件，把差異歸因於使用者不同（例如專業人士或新手）與平台設計不同（例如貼文字數限制）。

這不代表哪個平台比較準，摘要並沒有這樣說。它提醒的是：網路上的「大家怎麼看」，要先問是哪個平台的大家。

（研究分享，不是投資建議）
why: 近期盤前已談過注意力、Google 搜尋與券商 App，這篇換成社群平台情緒的角度，補上新的資料來源，也不重複台灣交易紀錄與散戶績效。

paper.title: The social signal
paper.abstract: We examine social media attention and sentiment from three major platforms: Twitter, StockTwits, and Seeking Alpha. We find that, even after controlling for firm disclosures and news, attention is highly correlated across platforms, but sentiment is not: its first principal component explains little more variation than purely idiosyncratic sentiment. Using market events, we attribute differences across platforms to differences in users (e.g., professionals versus novices) and differences in platform design (e.g., character limits in posts). We also find that sentiment and attention contain different return-relevant information. Sentiment predicts positive next-day returns, but attention predicts negative next-day returns. These results highlight the importance of considering both social media sentiment and attention, and of distinguishing between different investor social media platforms.

text:
🏭 產業前沿｜每秒 12.8 億個取樣，延遲約 40 奈秒：這是一篇論文替 320 MHz 的 Wi-Fi 7 訊號設定的處理規格。

論文做到的是：數位預失真（先把訊號反向扭曲，抵消功率放大器的非線性）改用只有 207 個參數、沒有遞迴的小網路。FPGA 即時測試在 320 MHz、4096-QAM 訊號上，鄰頻功率比為 −45.82 dBc。12 奈米晶片的數字是佈局後估計，每樣本約 111 pJ，比先前遞迴式設計低約七倍。

還沒做到的是：晶片尚未製造，論文把製造列為下一步；三個放大器的比較也是離線播放波形。如果成真，可能影響的是寬頻發射端在功耗與面積上的取捨，但這只是推論，論文並未驗證。

（研究分享，不是投資建議）
why: 近幾天的產業前沿多是 AI 記憶體、電源與電池材料，這篇切入無線通訊射頻與專用硬體加速器，主題不同，也避開已用過的題材。

paper.title: StreamingDPD: A 1.28-GSa/s Instantaneous-Power-Gated Depthwise TCN Accelerator for Real-Time 320-MHz Digital Predistortion
paper.abstract: State feedback between successive samples limits the streaming throughput of recurrent neural networks for digital predistortion (DPD). We present StreamingDPD, an accelerator that processes 320-MHz signals at 1.28 GSa/s. Its 207-parameter instantaneous-power-gated depthwise temporal convolutional network (IPG-DWTCN) uses $|x[n]|^2$ to gate feature channels and causal dilated depthwise convolutions to model power amplifier memory. The network maps to a spatially unrolled fixed-point pipeline with shift-based quadratic activations and layer-wise mixed precision, sustaining one complex sample per cycle per lane. Its algorithmic cost is 554 floating-point operations per complex sample, 30.1% fewer than the recurrent baseline with the best linearization performance. In RF playback measurements on three power amplifiers driven by 40- to 320-MHz Wi-Fi 6/7 and 5G NR waveforms, IPG-DWTCN achieves the lowest mean adjacent-channel power ratio (ACPR) and ranks first or ties for first in mean error vector magnitude (EVM) against five neural baselines of comparable size. Four-lane FPGA hardware-in-the-loop tests on a 320-MHz 4096-QAM Wi-Fi 7 waveform achieve -45.82 dBc ACPR and -42.94 dB EVM at 1.28 GSa/s. At the same sample rate, post-layout evaluation of a single-lane 12-nm FinFET ASIC yields a 0.10 mm$^2$ core, a 52-cycle (40.63 ns) latency, and an estimated typical-corner power of 142.21 mW (111.10 pJ/sample). Relative to the prior 22-nm recurrent DPD ASIC, the design provides 5.1 times the throughput at about one-seventh the energy per sample.

text:
🌙 盤後研究室｜同一個盈餘數字,其實要回答兩個問題:這消息有多好?以及這個數字值多少錢?

研究者請約900位有交易帳戶的美國成人,預測財報公布當天的股價反應(2024年12月的實驗,財報意外大小為隨機設定)。一半人被加上多餘的背景文字,還要在40秒內作答。

研究發現,受限組別的整體反應約減少四分之一,但對接近零的小意外,反應反而增加約四分之一。美股1984至2023年約22萬筆財報,也看到類似型態:估值不確定性較高的股票,平均反應較弱,小意外附近卻較敏感。

這是實驗預測加上統計關聯,不代表誰判斷錯了;作者認為這未必是失誤,也沒發現後續反轉。

你看財報時,注意的是數字的大小,還是「有沒有超預期」?

（研究分享，不是投資建議）
why: 近期貼文多在談注意力、散戶虧損與參與率，這篇是新的盈餘公告與學習題材，有實驗加真實公告資料，也能避開今天以特定公司為主的新聞標題。

paper.title: Huge If True: Learning from the Size of the Surprise
paper.abstract: Responses to earnings surprises depend on an unknown multiplier mapping earnings to value. Investors, however, learn about the news and the multiplier from the same number. Large surprises may indicate small multipliers and tiny surprises large ones. We model how greater uncertainty about the multiplier attenuates responses on average but makes them steeper near zero surprises. In an incentivized experiment, we find that greater processing constraints lower average sensitivity but raise it near zero. We confirm this with real-world earnings announcements: stocks with higher valuation uncertainty, our proxy for multiplier uncertainty, respond less on average but more steeply near zero.

text:
📈 盤前心理學｜同一張帳單，換個排版，你的決定會不會跟著變？

《The Journal of Finance》2019 年的一項研究，用中國券商的投資人層級資料做了自然實驗。有一次改變，讓一檔股票的「買進價格」變得更顯眼，但投資人手上的資訊其實沒有增加。

研究用差異中差異法比較後發現，這個顯眼度的衝擊，使處分效果（傾向賣出賺錢的股票、抱著賠錢的股票）增加了17%。研究也發現不同投資人受到的影響差異很大，而先前文獻提過的「排名效應」可以解釋這種差異。

這代表什麼？研究發現，資訊怎麼呈現，可能實際影響交易行為。但這不代表每個人都會同樣反應，更不是在告訴誰該怎麼操作。

註：以上僅根據論文摘要。

（研究分享，不是投資建議）
why: 這是還沒用過的因果證據研究，主題（介面呈現）和近日重複的注意力、當沖、散戶虧損不同，且有真實券商資料與具體數字可當開頭。

paper.title: The Impact of Salience on Investor Behavior: Evidence from a Natural Experiment
paper.abstract: We test whether the display of information causally affects investor behavior in a high‐stakes trading environment. Using investor‐level brokerage data from China and a natural experiment, we estimate the impact of a shock that increased the salience of a stock's purchase price but did not change the investor's information set. We employ a difference‐in‐differences approach and find that the salience shock causally increased the disposition effect by 17%. We use microdata to document substantial heterogeneity across investors in the treatment effect. A previously documented trading pattern, the “rank effect,” explains heterogeneity in the change in the disposition effect.

text:
🏭 產業前沿｜資料中心蓋得快,電網卻接不上:論文引用的資料指出,新輸電設施常要四到八年,資料中心約兩到三年就能營運。

愛丁堡大學團隊問:如果運算工作能「換地方做」(互動請求轉送)、「晚點做」(批次工作最多延後6小時),同一張電網能多接多少容量?

他們用修改過的IEEE 118匯流排測試系統,模擬三座資料中心、全年8760小時。只延後執行,容量增加21.26%;只跨地點調度,增加5.37%;兩者並用,從4635.1 MW增至6231.5 MW,增加34.44%,且不擴建電網。

論文做到的是模擬量化,不是實際部署;工作類型比例是假設,模擬中的年運作成本也較高。如果成真,可能影響的是電網擴建與資料中心建置的節奏,但這點論文並未檢驗。

（研究分享，不是投資建議）
why: 近期午間已談過記憶體、電池材料、HBM與資料中心供電，這篇接續AI基礎設施主題，但切入點是運算彈性與電網容量，角度不重複，也符合本週AI基礎設施與非AI硬體交替的計畫。

paper.title: Quantifying the hosting capacity value of workload flexibility for AI data centers: A two-stage electricity-computation co-optimization framework
paper.abstract: Grid connection constraints increasingly limit the expansion of AI data centers, yet the additional hosting capacity enabled by computational workload flexibility remains insufficiently quantified. This paper develops a two-stage electricity--computation co-optimization framework to quantify the individual and coordinated hosting capacity values of spatial and temporal workload flexibility. Data center capacities are determined endogenously, with computational task arrivals scaling with admitted capacity. Spatial routing of eligible interactive requests and temporal deferral of batch workloads are linked to server operation and facility power demand, subject to workload completion requirements and transmission constraints. The first stage maximizes aggregate hosting capacity; the second fixes the resulting site capacities and optimizes annual workload scheduling and generation dispatch to minimize generation and carbon costs. An 8760-hour case study with three data centers on a modified IEEE 118-bus system shows that temporal and spatial flexibility individually increase hosting capacity by 21.26\% and 5.37\%, respectively. Their coordinated use raises hosting capacity from 4635.1~MW to 6231.5~MW, a 34.44\% increase without network reinforcement. The coordinated gain exceeds the sum of the individual gains by 361.9~MW, demonstrating complementarity between spatial migration and temporal deferral. By redistributing computational demand across locations and operating hours, these mechanisms enable fuller utilization of existing transmission capacity. The findings establish workload flexibility as a quantifiable planning resource for accommodating additional data center capacity within existing transmission networks.

text:
🌙 盤後研究室｜一個有點反直覺的現象：有一類基金，投資人比較常申購它，也比較常贖回它。

研究發現，共同基金投資人對「特異波動」高的基金，申購與贖回的可能性都更高。作者的解釋之一是，這類基金的報酬更極端，因此更顯眼。研究把過去多個期間的極端報酬納入控制後，特異波動對新資金流入的影響下降；實驗證據也顯示，讓極端報酬更醒目，投資人對特異波動的需求會上升。研究還發現，散戶與原本較不顯眼的基金，這種需求更高。

這不代表投資人都被極端報酬牽著走，摘要只說極端報酬吸引注意力，並可能助長申購時的追求風險傾向。

晚上問問自己：上次注意到某檔標的，是因為研究過它，還是因為它的極端漲跌剛好很搶眼？

（研究分享，不是投資建議）
why: 近期貼文多談個股與當沖，這篇是基金投資人資料加實驗，延續讀者愛看的自身行為題材，又與之前的關注度研究換了角度，也避開今天的市場大跌與個股新聞。

paper.title: Salience and Mutual Fund Investor Demand for Idiosyncratic Volatility
paper.abstract: We find that mutual fund investors are more likely to both purchase and redeem funds with high idiosyncratic volatility (IV). Investors’ tendency to purchase high IV funds is largely driven by high IV funds having more extreme returns, which increases the salience of the fund. Including flexible controls for extreme past returns over multiple horizons decreases the effect of IV on new investment, and experimental evidence corroborates that increasing the salience of extreme returns increases investor demand for IV. Demand for IV is higher among retail investors and funds with otherwise lower salience. Collectively, the evidence suggests that extreme returns attract investor attention and contribute to investors’ risk seeking behavior when purchasing mutual funds. This paper was accepted by David Simchi-Levi, finance.

text:
📈 盤前心理學｜62.5%——這是近千人看無聲短影片，猜「AI 生成還是真人拍攝」的平均正確率。

這項線上實驗收了 973 位美國成人的資料（2025 年 11 月）。研究發現，大家平均把自己排在比實際高約 12.8 個百分位的位置；表現最差的四分之一正確率約 45%，卻預期自己能答對約 59%。另外，確定感超過實際表現的人，分享意願也較高。

這是影片辨識，不是投資研究，也只是相關，不能說自信過頭「造成」分享。但可以當面鏡子：看到網路上的消息時，我的把握有多少是真的有根據？🤔

（研究分享，不是投資建議）
why: 最近幾天都在談交易頻率、注意力與介面，這篇是新的過度自信題材，樣本近千人、有明確數字，也貼近讀者每天刷到真假難辨資訊的經驗，且完全不涉及個股或行情。

paper.title: Sure Enough to Share? Overconfidence in GenAI Video Discernment is Associated with Sharing Intentions
paper.abstract: Generative Artificial Intelligence (GenAI) is blurring the line between synthesized and recorded videos, but less is known about people's awareness of their discernment abilities and the consequences of miscalibration. This study examines three forms of overconfidence in GenAI video discernment (i.e., overestimation, overplacement, and overprecision) and their associations with source judgments and sharing intentions in an online study (N = 973). Participants evaluated videos depicting everyday scenes and achieved 62.5% accuracy. Three forms of overconfidence showed distinct patterns: participants overplaced themselves by 12.8 percentile points, but overprecision showed consistent positive associations with sharing intentions and the tendency to classify videos as human-made. Age, GenAI usage, and AI literacy showed consistent positive associations with all three forms of overconfidence. These findings highlight the importance of distinguishing the three forms of overconfidence to better understand GenAI engagement and incorporating metacognition into interventions to support informed media consumption.

text:
🏭 產業前沿｜AI 代理程式等一次模型回覆，中位數約 2.7 秒；實際運算只佔估計的 5 到 40 毫秒（區間估計，非直接量測）。

在作者部署的「每段對話一個獨立環境」代理平台上（單一客服基準、一種模型、兩套框架），一千段對話據推算只用 2 到 15 顆核心；桌機模擬模型的直接測量約 3.8 到 9.3 顆。並非所有平台都這樣設計。

以下皆為模擬：該平台閒置預設 15 分鐘才回收，33 秒的對話若不關閉，佔用是 28 倍（933/33）；64 段共用一個環境可少 59 倍，第 99 百分位最多多等 40 毫秒（無思考時間、2 vCPU 環境；256 段且運算偏高時過載）。

論文做到的是量測與模擬；如果成真，容量規劃可能要看同時對話數。這是客戶端視角，並非平台成本。

（研究分享，不是投資建議）
why: 近幾天午間產業前沿多談記憶體、電力與無線訊號，這篇改談 AI 代理服務在雲端的資源預留，角度新、有具體數字，也呼應頻道自我檢討中偏向 AI 基礎設施的建議。

paper.title: Held While Waiting: What LLM Agent Sessions Reserve on Serverless and Agent Runtimes
paper.abstract: LLM agents spend nearly all their time waiting for the model. On Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, our agents waited a median of 2.7 seconds for each model reply, then computed for an estimated 5 to 40 milliseconds. AgentCore does not charge for CPU during the wait. But it reserves a separate environment, a virtual machine with its own memory, for every conversation, and keeps it reserved until the conversation is closed. So 1,000 conversations reserve 1,000 environments to do the work of 2 to 15 processor cores. A service runs out of environments long before it runs out of processing power. The shortage has two causes, and each has a fix. An environment stays reserved after its conversation ends: in the customer-service benchmark we ran, a conversation lasts 33 seconds on average, but its environment is held for 15 minutes more unless the client closes it. And an environment serves only one conversation, which is mostly waiting: in our simulation, 64 conversations sharing one environment need 59 times fewer environments, and 99 of every 100 replies are delayed by at most 40 milliseconds. The milliseconds are an estimate because they are hard to measure: a stubbed model, a timer around the model call, and steps run back to back each gave a plausible number that was too low. We show how to avoid all three. Of the two fixes, closing needs only the client. Sharing needs the platform, and of the agent runtimes we surveyed only one allows it, in part. They keep conversations apart because an agent runs tools, and sometimes code, chosen by a model. The open problem is to keep them apart without reserving an environment for each while it waits.

text:
🌙 盤後研究室｜住在一個房價連漲好幾年的城市，你會覺得接下來房價會怎麼走？

一篇用密西根消費者調查的研究發現，人們的房價預期，會跟著所在城市最近的房價走勢走。而且預測誤差是可預測的：人們傾向低估動能、忽略均值回歸。長期上漲之後，樂觀情緒會再持續好幾季；下跌時則反過來。研究也發現，房價上漲會讓更多人認為房地產是好的投資。

這是一種「用近期經驗推測未來」的偏誤。

要留意的是，這項研究談的是預期如何形成，不是在預測房價，也不代表每個人都這樣想。🏠

（研究分享，不是投資建議）
why: 近期貼文多集中在券商交易、注意力與搜尋量，這篇是房市預期的新題材，且可帶出經驗外推的概念，與今天的市場標題保持距離，避免把研究說成能解釋當日走勢。

paper.title: House price history, biased expectations, and credit cycles: The role of housing investors
paper.abstract: Using the Michigan Survey, I show that consumers' house price expectations depend upon the recent history of house price developments in their city of residence. Forecast errors are predictable: people systematically underestimate momentum and neglect mean reversion, remaining over‐optimistic for several quarters after a prolonged trend of house price growth, and vice versa. Housing appreciation also increases the share of consumers who believe that real estate is a good investment. Combining loan‐level data from Freddie Mac to regional measures of housing sentiment, I show that an exogenous shift in house price expectations leads to an increase in leverage on new mortgage originations. The effect is concentrated on investment properties and among prime borrowers in nonrecourse states.

text:
📈 盤前心理學｜8 百萬筆交易、87,373 位投資人：跟著大家做，是一時興起，還是一種習慣？

一項研究分析某家歐洲大型券商的法國散戶交易紀錄（1999 至 2006 年），替每位投資人算出「跟隨群眾」的程度。研究發現，這種傾向有持續性：相鄰兩季的相關約 12.43%，四年內仍顯著。不過作者也提醒，這種持續性相對偏弱。

研究還發現，前幾季投資組合表現較差的人，下一季跟著大家交易的傾向較高。交易次數少的投資人，平均比交易頻繁的人更常跟隨；有交易權證的人，平均則較少跟隨。

這是 1999 至 2006 年法國單一券商的資料，且為工作論文，呈現的是行為上的關聯，不是任何人該怎麼操作的建議。

（研究分享，不是投資建議）
why: 這篇用真實交易紀錄談散戶行為，主題貼近讀者，也和近日的過度交易、注意力與性別題材不同，是新角度。

paper.title: What drives the herding behavior of individual investors?
paper.abstract: L’objet de cet article est d’analyser la dynamique du comportement moutonnier (ou de herding) des investisseurs individuels. Dans ce but, nous introduisons une mesure originale de herding permettant un suivi individuel de ce comportement. Sur la base de l’analyse de 8 millions de transactions, réalisées par 87 373 investisseurs individuels sur la période 1999 - 2006, nous mettons en lumière la persistance temporelle de ce comportement ainsi que le rôle prépondérant joué par les performances passées des portefeuilles et la sophistication des investisseurs. La mesure proposée nous permet en outre de répondre à une question peu abordée dans la littérature : le comportement de herding est-il profitable à l’investisseur ? Nos résultats indiquent que les portefeuilles des investisseurs les moins moutonniers présentent d’avantage de rendements extrêmes et de plus faibles couples rendement/risque que les autres investisseurs.

text:
🏭 產業前沿｜光電二極體平常只回答一個問題：光有多強。這篇論文問：只改變供電方式，它能不能也分辨光的「顏色」？

論文做到的是：一顆未改裝的商用 InGaAs 光電二極體，不加濾光片，只施加正弦偏壓，再讓神經網路解讀 10 微秒的光電流波形。在 1530–1610 nm 波段，能定位 1 至 3 條雷射譜線，誤差約 0.3–0.4 nm。

但這仍是實驗室示範：光源是 4 或 8 mW 雷射，不是連續寬頻光譜。換到沒參與校正的日子，單線平均誤差從 1.79 nm 降到 0.80 nm，但那是同時加入實測的日間漂移資料、並平均五種訊號表示法的結果。七天各自的誤差範圍，也從 0.70–5.08 nm 縮到 0.34–1.93 nm，差異仍大。

如果成真，可能讓光通訊與感測模組用較簡單的現成元件多取得波長資訊。這是可能性，不是論文證明的。

（研究分享，不是投資建議）
why: 近幾天午間都是 AI 伺服器、記憶體與通訊題材，這篇換成非 AI 的感測與光學硬體，符合筆記建議的對照，也讓產業前沿的角度更多樣。

paper.title: From power to spectrum: an off-the-shelf photodiode turned into a spectrometer by its bias alone
paper.abstract: Computational spectrometers replace dispersive optics with detectors whose spectral response can be varied, but every reported single-detector device obtains this response through dedicated fabrication: two-dimensional heterostructures, graded epitaxial junctions, organic stacks, filters or photonic circuits. We demonstrate a generic, fabrication-free alternative in which a standard commercial photodiode becomes a spectrometer through its electrical drive alone, requiring no modification of the device, no optical filter and no modulation of the light. The mechanism is bias-modulated optoelectronic chromatic dispersion (OED): light of different wavelengths is absorbed at different depths, and a sinusoidal bias changes how carriers generated at each depth are collected, so that every spectrum is encoded in the shape of the photocurrent waveform over one bias period. Applied to an unmodified InGaAs PIN photodiode at room temperature, a 10 us waveform decoded by a neural network reconstructs spectra of one to three laser lines across the 80 nm of the telecom C+L band, locating the lines to 0.3-0.4 nm, counting them in about 99% of measurements and identifying their power levels, with line shifts tracked to tens of picometres. Because OED relies on universal semiconductor transport physics, the approach is material-agnostic and applies in principle to any off-the-shelf photodiode, turning detectors already deployed as power monitors into low-cost spectral sensors.

🌙 盤後研究室｜頭條寫著「股市最慘烈一周天天跌，二戰以來僅有5次」。每逢這種日子，新聞總會附上一串理由。

這些理由到底能解釋多少？一篇2026年的論文，用生成式AI從《華爾街日報》每日市場摘要抽出「理由」，並濾掉直接描述漲跌的字眼，再對照2002至2024年的美股大盤報酬。

研究發現，總經、現金流等傳統變數對月報酬的樣本外解釋力不到10%，多數甚至是負值；新聞理由的解釋力，日報酬和月報酬都約30至40%。

但這是事後解釋，不是預測。作者也說，理由不保證就是真正成因。這項研究並未檢視本週行情。

（研究分享，不是投資建議）
why: 週末頭條都在找下跌原因，正好可以介紹研究對「事後解釋」與「事前預測」差距的發現，也避開近期已用過的交易行為題材。

paper.title: Explaining Realized Returns: Roll's $R^2$ 40 Years Later
paper.abstract: Can we explain asset price movements even with hindsight? Reinterpreting Roll's (1988) AFA Presidential Address, "$R^2$," as a modern empirical exercise, we show that conventional macroeconomic, cash-flow, expectations, and flow variables explain less than 10% (often with negative $R^2$) of monthly U.S. equity return variation out of sample and lack daily observations. We use generative AI to extract reasons stated in Wall Street Journal market summaries while filtering out price-related language. These reasons explain around 30-40% of daily and monthly return variation out of sample. Their content spans interpretable themes, including corporate news, macroeconomic conditions, monetary policy, sentiment, and geopolitics.

📈 盤前心理學｜散戶在網路上聊股票時，到底在聊什麼？

有位研究者分析了大量網路股票留言板和投資社群的貼文，想直接看投資人對會計資訊的關注。研究發現，大家特別盯著三樣東西：盈餘、現金和營收。

討論熱度也不是一直平平的：在盈餘公告和 8-K 報告送出前後會升高。不過定期報告引起的反應，只出現在小型公司。另外，資訊環境比較差的時候，投資人似乎會更努力去找資訊、處理資訊。

但摘要也指出，財報公布時討論得越多，並沒有明顯對應到更好的資訊處理。

這是線上社群的文字資料，只能看出大家在聊什麼，不代表聊得多就判斷得準。

（研究分享，不是投資建議）
why: 近期已談過 Google 搜尋、社群平台比較和群眾跟隨,這篇從會計資訊的角度補上散戶注意力的新面向,且題材貼近讀者自己的看盤習慣,摘要裡有具體可引用的內容。

paper.title: Individual Investors' Attention to Accounting Information: Evidence from Online Financial Communities*
paper.abstract: Online financial communities provide a unique opportunity to directly examine individual investors' attention to accounting information on a large scale and in great detail. I analyze accounting‐related content in large samples of Yahoo! message board posts and StockTwits and find investors pay attention to a range of accounting information, fixating particularly on earnings, cash, and revenues. Consistent with the expectation that investors react to relevant information events, I find accounting‐related discussion elevated around the filings of earnings releases and 8‐K reports, but the reaction to periodic reports is confined to small firms. I also find investors expand their acquisition of accounting information and processing efforts in poor information environments. Greater attention to accounting information at earnings releases does not appear to be meaningfully associated with better information processing.

🏭 產業前沿｜240 倍:一篇預印本在模擬測試中宣稱,新解碼器的邏輯錯誤率比現有即時硬體解碼器低這麼多。

量子電腦糾錯,需要傳統晶片即時讀取錯誤線索,還得跟上超導量子位元約每微秒一輪的節奏。過去夠快的解碼器多半犧牲準確度,得靠更多量子位元補。

論文做到的是:把神經網路改成適合 FPGA 的形式,在距離 19 的表面碼上,單片每輪不到 1 微秒、延遲約 20 微秒。論文估算,同樣錯誤率下,union-find 需要每個邏輯位元 1,921 個實體量子位元,這個設計只要 721 個。

如果成真,可能影響的是:解碼硬體也要和量子位元一起算進成本。

但結果來自模擬雜訊,晶片版只是 7 nm 的估算。論文也說,若每個邏輯位元用一片 FPGA,數千個邏輯位元需要數百千瓦;客製晶片與高效率編碼各可能降低約一個數量級,但前提是兩者的節省能同時成立。

（研究分享，不是投資建議）
why: 近期午間已連續談過記憶體、電網、無線射頻與光感測，量子糾錯的傳統硬體是新的產業角度，也能和上週的非AI硬體做對照，且摘要有明確的速度與準確度取捨可以講清楚。

paper.title: Scaling classical hardware for accurate real-time quantum error correction
paper.abstract: Fault-tolerant quantum computation requires a classical decoder fast enough to process syndrome measurements at the rate at which they are generated, and to return its decisions with low latency. This is most demanding for superconducting processors, whose fast syndrome cycles force a trade-off between decoding speed and accuracy. Decoders fast enough to keep up sacrifice accuracy, which must be compensated for with larger codes and thus additional physical qubits. Here we introduce Rapids, a streaming neural decoder that is both fast and accurate. We achieve this by co-designing the decoder with a field-programmable gate array (FPGA): the network is built from operations that map cheaply onto the device and trained in its integer arithmetic. For the distance-19 surface code, Rapids decodes each round of syndromes in under a microsecond on a single FPGA, fast enough for superconducting processors, and returns its decisions with the low latency that fault-tolerant algorithms require. Its logical error rate is 240 times lower than that of existing real-time hardware decoders. The same design extends to the color code and the [[144,12,12]] bivariate-bicycle code, on which our decoder is 16 times more accurate than the real-time Relay decoder. We further show that the decoder scales: spread over several FPGAs or hardened into custom silicon, it becomes faster, more accurate, or able to decode larger codes. Classical hardware thus becomes a further resource, alongside qubits, that can be scaled to improve fault-tolerant quantum computers.
